notes.title: Veg out Crew 2D Racer Coming Closer!
notes.content:
It's getting closer to Christmas and we're getting closer to release!

Been working on some new tracks lately, which are starting to come together, along with some new cars and weapons. Each track also has some cool secrets, faster paths, and more!

Here's a quick sneak peak!

Blueberry track:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147517/d74331838a7682b079ecfd89eaa3a8ac102a35a0.png[/img]

Tomato track:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147517/7264eb7ecceb2ac9aa7143a78a36111f0982cfaa.png[/img]

Broccoli track:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147517/66792ac9812647abf052bddba5ee742fff029d81.png[/img]

We're also going to be revamping some of the GUI maybe all, as I'm not 100% happy with how it's all put together right now, so stay tuned!

Anway, there's an update on the 2D Racer, coming out soon!!

Happy Vegging!

notes.title: VoC 2D Racer is now on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1][b]We're on STEAM[/b][/h1]
Veg out Crew are taking it to the track, with an all new 2d racing game. Veg out Crew 2D Racer is in the works and we now finally have a steam page!

[h2][b]Race, Shoot, Boost, Dodge and do it all![/b][/h2]
Get ready to race within the Veg out World, non stop action, your favourite veg out cars, weapons and radical tracks. Your level of skills and experience will play a massive part in gaining the place of the most heroic racer the Veg out Crew have seen!

Check out some of the imagery below and what else are you waiting for? Buckle up, get locked and loaded and race your way to stardom!
